reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

This comes from the incident messages on 2025-09-03, in a channel Tobias is a member of. Priyanka said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She closed the incident at 18:43 that day, saying Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give an address or any other site details for Southgate, and I couldn't see any Tansley account files in the share. I told him that rather than guess.
